description: Entités chargées du déploiement du Plan France Très Haut Débit sur le périmètre de la Communauté urbaine de Dunkerque is a dataset listed in Open Data Dunkerque Agglomération, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Communauté urbaine de Dunkerque. Entités en charge du déploiement du Plan France Très Haut Débit sur le périmètre de la Communauté urbaine de Dunkerque. Coverage: Dunkirk urban community. The portal files it under Numérique. Its keywords are fibre, FTTH, Plan France Très Haut Débit. The portal shows 17 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2018-12-20 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODbL-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-dunkerque-agglo-fr-portal.
